command:
cat >/dev/null
o=holds; r='every input has content'
for f in /inputs/*; do [ -s "$f" ] || { o=does_not_hold; r="$(basename "$f") is empty"; }; done
printf '{"protocol":"capsulet.verifier/v1","results":[{"obligation":"inputs-not-empty","contract":"template","outcome":"%s","reason":"%s"}]}' "$o" "$r"
